scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix client && npm run check --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
